entries.text: DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-01: CRITICAL - trade close reconciliation broken two ways. (1) mt5_bridge.py:1138 history_deals_get(dates, position=ticket) ignores the position filter (28 deals vs 2) and books the first stranger DEAL_ENTRY_OUT it finds - gold #1682651222 truly lost -441.84 but would have been recorded +7.25 from another EA's BTCUSD deal, so consecutive_losses resets instead of incrementing and the 3-loss breaker cannot fire. (2) known_positions is in-memory (line 97) so closes during bridge downtime are never seen - that gold trade hit SL 07-31 12:12:45 and journal still says OPEN/pnl null. Result: stats/by-setup noData, growth trades=0, learning setupStats={} after 66 sessions. Also: untagged bridge on #11581419 via auto-detect while the SmartEntry trade lives on #25446287; account 25446287 shared with 5 foreign EAs. 4 tasks created.

DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-01 (session run, 05:0x): CONFIRMED the real outcome of the stranded trade via direct MT5 history read on account 25446287 — XAUUSD BUY 0.14 opened 07-30 19:43:39 @4104.01, stopped out 07-31 12:12:45 @4061.59, profit -441.84, magic 20250101, comment 'SE BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH 85'. Journal still says OPEN/pnl null. Downtime window identified: watchdog_log has no entries between 31/07 02:46 and 01/08 04:53 and startup_all ran fresh at 04:52 — the machine was off while the stop hit, which is exactly why known_positions (in-memory) missed it. Also verified account 11581419 has ZERO magic-20250101 deals in 12 days, so the duplicate untagged bridge has not yet cost anything. history_deals_get(dates, position=) filter confirmed ignored: 28 deals returned instead of 2.

PARALLEL BUILD launched 2026-08-01 ~05:30 — 4 workstreams: (1) mt5_bridge.py close-detection: history_deals_get(position=) alone + position_id match, NO magic filter on close side, plus startup reconciliation of OPEN journal entries; (2) parallel_analysis.py synthesiser JSON parse + one retry + non-zero exit on failure; (3) OVERRIDE_SETTING/OVERRIDE_VALUE threading into server/index.js so the sweep stops being a no-op; (4) remove untagged 3rd bridge from start_all.bat/startup.bat + MT5_EXPECTED_LOGIN on A/B. CORRECTED A STALE BELIEF: VPS Claude CLI IS logged in and working (claude -p returns EXIT=0), command/agent parity is exact 44/44 and 6/6 — the real VPS failure is the synthesiser, not auth. NEW BUG FOUND: auto-tune sweep is a no-op, adxTrendingMin 15/20/25/30 give byte-identical trade counts. STILL PENDING USER APPROVAL: backfill of journal #1682651222 as CLOSED -441.84 (protected data, must not be written without explicit Y). NOT YET ADDRESSED: firing rate — conf is 0/0/45 vs a 65 gate on BOTH machines because daily timeframe is BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH; index.js:1071 collapses confidence to 0 whenever daily says WAIT.

DAILY-CHECK 2026-08-01 17:30 (session 2): WIN - the close-detection fix from last session WORKED unattended. Journal #1682651222 is now CLOSED, pnl -449.72 (raw MT5 was -441.84; the extra -7.88 is commission+swap, exactly as the fix intended). learning.json setupStats is NO LONGER EMPTY after 67 sessions: BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH 0W/1L -449.72. No manual backfill was needed - reconcile_open_trades() did it on bridge start. LIVE INCIDENT: Bridge A is running and MT5-connected (17:01:22, #25446287, Program Files terminal) but has posted ZERO heartbeats since that connect; healer reads 1/2 expected accounts, A silent 1268s. Every 60s cycle logs 'No MT5 bars available to push'. Bridge B (11581419) is healthy and is the sole feed for all 3 signals (dataSource=mt5 on all). Analyst agent running on root cause. STRUCTURAL: no trades today is not the market - all 3 assets are in a simultaneous DAILY BB squeeze (BTC bw 6.0%, GOLD 4.6%, SPX 3.5%), setup BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH which always emits signal WAIT, and index.js:1071 'confidence = daily.signal===WAIT ? 0 : 40' hard-zeroes it. BTC 0, GOLD 0, SPX 45 (rescued only by the isH4Only branch, still 20pt short of the 65 gate). Nothing can fire while the squeeze holds. Analyst agent measuring whether unmuting that cohort is real edge. NEW BUG FOUND: the 3-consecutive-loss circuit breaker cannot accumulate. mt5_bridge.py:104 consecutive_losses is a plain in-memory global zeroed on every bridge start (restarts today at 04:52 and 17:00:56), AND reconcile_open_trades() at line 1342-1350 deliberately does not feed it. So a loss that closes while the bridge is down never counts, and any restart resets the count to 0. Combined with account 11581419 being traded by two machines with separate counters, the advertised '3 consecutive losses' guardrail is materially weaker than the config claims. Also: GET /api/performance returns 404 despite being advertised in CLAUDE.md. Inventory verified: .mcp.json has 8 servers and MCP is live this session, 44 commands, 6 agents.

SHIPPED 2026-08-01 94cf1b9: circuit breaker now persists. consecutive_losses/daily_pnl were module globals zeroed on every bridge start, so the 3-loss breaker could never accumulate; reconcile_open_trades also excluded them, which is why #1682651222 (-449.72) reached the journal and learning engine but never the breaker. Now persisted to tasks/breaker_state_<TAG>.json (gitignored - per-machine live state), streak carries across days+restarts until a win clears it, dailyPnl scoped to the day the close actually happened, reconcile gated on last_counted_close so restarts cannot re-fold history. Daily-limit halt expires with its day, streak halt does not. Fails open on corrupt file. 16/16 stubbed assertions pass, py_compile clean, pushed. Does NOT fix the two-machines-one-account split brain on 11581419. CORRECTION TO MY OWN EARLIER HYPOTHESIS THIS SESSION: I said the bridge heartbeat was coupled to a successful candle push. That is WRONG - analyst disproved it. mt5LastSeenByAccount is written ONLY by POST /api/mt5/positions (server/index.js:2061-2067); push_candles and report_positions are independent calls in the main loop. REAL ROOT CAUSE of Bridge A: MT5's own terminal log shows the terminal A connected to EXITED 1.19s after A's single heartbeat (17:01:23.979 'Terminal exit with code 0') as part of a LiveUpdate restart chain; PID 27556 is a SECOND instance started 17:01:29. Bridge A has held a stale IPC handle ever since - copy_rates_from_pos and positions_get both return None, and report_positions() line 899-900 'if positions is None: return' suppresses the heartbeat with no log. connect_mt5() is called ONLY in the startup retry loop (1410-1416); there is no mt5.initialize anywhere in the while True body and connect_mt5 never checks terminal_info().connected, so a bridge whose terminal dies runs forever, logs 'no bars', and never reconnects. B is healthy only because its terminal started 45s BEFORE its bridge; A's terminal was launched BY mt5.initialize 32s after, which is exactly the instance that runs the LiveUpdate dance. SECOND CRITICAL: tasks/watchdog.bat polls /api/mt5/health?account=A and restarts on 503 - correct logic - but it is DEAD. Last log line '[01/08/2026 17:00:26.31] Watchdog started.' and no cmd.exe running it; suspect 'timeout /t 60 /nobreak' failing with input-redirection error under the 'start /min cmd /c' launch. Detection worked (healer flagged A silent), remediation never ran. ALSO: push_candles never advances _last_candle_push_at on failure (set only at line 316 after raise_for_status), so the 300s throttle is defeated and it hot-retries every 60s. ALSO: the 16:36 413s were a red herring - JSON_BODY_LIMIT is already 2mb since 003c4ec; those hit the PREVIOUS node process running pre-fix code in memory. Lesson: a long-lived node process silently serves stale code. NOT YET FIXED: A reconnect guard, watchdog resurrection, heartbeat None-vs-empty distinction, candle throttle. Analyst 2 (squeeze cohort measurement) still running.

SESSION 2 COMPLETE 2026-08-01 ~19:10. FIVE COMMITS 94cf1b9..ea30c34, all pushed, VPS deployed to ea30c34 via clean fast-forward with learning.json + jarvis_memory.json SHA-256 verified UNCHANGED (backup at C:\vps-state-backup-20260801-190711, 13 files). LOCAL LIVE INCIDENT RESOLVED: healer went 1/2 'A silent 1268s' -> 2/2 reporting, healthy:true. SHIPPED: (1) 94cf1b9 breaker persistence - streak survives restarts, dailyPnl scoped to the day the close happened, reconcile gated on last_counted_close, 16/16 tests. (2) 2823ae8 MT5 stale-handle reconnect - ensure_mt5_connection() every cycle, reconcile-then-reseed on recovery, positions_get None vs () separated in BOTH track_closed_positions and report_positions, candle throttle stamps the attempt. 18/18 tests. (3) 9e48c24 watchdog guardian + /t on bridge kills + marker-file cooldown + heartbeat. (4) ea30c34 VPS watchdog heartbeat. ROOT CAUSE OF THE BLIND BRIDGE (analyst, from MT5's own terminal log): the terminal A connected to EXITED 1.19s after A's only heartbeat, part of a LiveUpdate restart chain; a second instance came up 5s later. A held a dead IPC handle. B survived only because its terminal was up 45s BEFORE it, while A's was launched BY mt5.initialize 32s after - that is the instance that runs the update. My own earlier hypothesis (heartbeat coupled to candle push) was WRONG: mt5LastSeenByAccount is written only by POST /api/mt5/positions. WATCHDOG: its loop is NOT broken - an instrumented copy ran 5 clean cycles. It has no supervisor, that is all. Guardian added; a lock-file design was written and DISCARDED after catching the bug live - cmd passes handles to children so the bridge wrapper PID 6776 held .guardian.lock after watchdog and guardian were both dead, which would have blocked every future guardian. Now a WQL process count in tasks/count_guardians.ps1 that fails SAFE (returns 99). VPS deliberately NOT given the guardian or the /t fix: it restarts bridges via schtasks (MultipleInstances IgnoreNew, cannot stack) and already runs as a task with RestartCount=3. STILL UNKNOWN: what kills the local watchdog ~30s in. Guardian resurrects it in 10s so it is contained, not solved. ANALYST 2 (squeeze cohort) - MAJOR: my premise was WRONG for 2 of 3 assets. Daily BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH does NOT mute BTC/Gold - isH4Only rescues them and they clear 65 routinely (Gold 81/81 H4-STRONG steps >=65). Only SPX is hard-capped (max 60) and SPX is the one cohort measurably NEGATIVE in both halves - leave the cap. REAL EDGE: Gold + daily squeeze + H4 MODERATE, pinned at conf 55, TRAIN +0.179 TEST +0.607. Needs daily.setup=='BB_SQUEEZE_WATCH' gating - a blanket edit nets EXACTLY ZERO in TRAIN because it also unmutes Gold's daily-WAIT cohort (-0.518 train). HARNESS BUG: tasks/_replay_mtf.cjs never extracts SIZING_BOOST_MIN_CONFIDENCE (index.js:1367), so generateSignalMTF throws on Gold's isDailyNeutralH4 path and the catch swallows it - 1131 of 6225 Gold steps silently dropped, 18%. walkforward-latest.json reports exactly 260 Gold trades = the broken number. EVERY Gold figure from that harness is unreliable. 'Edge lives above 75' is SUPERSEDED: measured on the broken harness. Corrected, >=75 is a train artifact (+0.358 TRAIN -> +0.054 TEST, >=80 and >=85 go negative out-of-sample); >=70 is the only gate positive in 5/5 folds with TEST above TRAIN. ALSO FOUND: structural stop has no minimum distance (index.js:1006-1012), one SPX trade came out at rr 55.24 and contributed +55.2R of a +39.5R cohort total - it WAS the result and flipped the sign. NOT DONE, NEEDS DECISION: Gold squeeze unmute (signal-gen, needs your Y), harness sizing-const fix, structural-stop floor, gate 65->70.
